content.title: Who are Kentucky Derby 2026 horses? Trainers, jockeys, owners for each
content.text: Updated April 22, 2026, 10:52 a.m. ETCommandment and Further Ado, who are both trained by Louisville native Brad Cox, are at the top of the Kentucky Derby 2026 points leaderboard.Renegade, who is trained by Todd Pletcher, rounds out the top three in the 2026 Run for the Roses standings.Here are the current points standings for the 2026 Kentucky Derby.The top 20 horses in the final standings will earn a spot in the 2026 Kentucky Derby on May 2 at Churchill Downs. Invitations also will be extended to the top two horses in the Euro/Mideast Road to the Kentucky Derby and the top horse in the Japan Road to the Kentucky Derby.Ties in the points standings are broken by earnings in non-restricted stakes.Buy tickets to Kentucky Derby 152 at Churchill DownsKentucky Derby 2026 points leaderboard1. Ocelli, 25Trainer: Whit Beckman.Jockey: Joe Ramos.Sire: Connect.Last race: Third in Grade 2 Wood Memorial on April 4 at Aqueduct.Likely next race: TBA.How to watch the Kentucky Derby 2026TV channel: NBCLivestream: Peacock (subscriber only)In May of 2024, NBC Sports announced a partnership with Churchill Downs to present the Kentucky Derby on NBC and Peacock through 2032.The extension includes multi-platform rights to the Kentucky Derby, Kentucky Oaks and Derby and Oaks Day programming, which will be presented on NBC, Peacock, USA Network and additional NBCU platforms.What time is the Kentucky Derby?Post time for the 152nd Kentucky Derby is set for 6:57 p.m. on Saturday, May 2.Jason Frakes: 502-582-4046; jfrakes@courier-journal.com; Follow on X @KentuckyDerby_CJ
